projects.name: ODOT TIMS Projects - Next 4 Fiscal Years (Lines)
projects.notes: ODOT TIMS (Ellis project system). Projects scheduled in the next four state fiscal years; FISCAL_YEAR gives the sale year, AWARD_MILESTONE_DT the award date, BEGIN_CONSTR_MILESTONE_DT / END_CONSTR_MILESTONE_DT construction dates, STIP_FLAG whether in the STIP. Planned vs under way: PROJECT_STATUS (see values) plus AWARD_MILESTONE_DT in the future; CONSTR_VENDOR_NME is null until awarded. Sibling services in the same folder: Current_Projects_Lines/Points (active), All_Projects_Linear / All_Project_Points, Previous_4_Fiscal_Years_*, District_Work_Plan_*.

parcels_counties.notes: Franklin County Auditor tax parcels (Columbus). MAILNME1/MAILNME2 hold the owner's address lines; PSTLNME1/PSTLADDRES/PSTLCITYSTZIP are the tax-bill mailing party (often a mortgage servicer).

City of Cleveland open data 'Property Insights' (labelled public draft) built from county fiscal office data; covers Cleveland parcels only, not the rest of Cuyahoga County. The county's own server (gis.cuyahogacounty.gov) timed out from the research network and could not be verified.

Hamilton County Auditor (Cincinnati) parcel polygons view; service name is dated 2024-10-08 so it may be a static snapshot. OWNAD1/OWNAD2/OWNADCITY/OWNADSTATE/OWNADZIP are the owner address, ML* the tax mailing name/address. A CAGIS open-data layer with the same schema exists at https://services.arcgis.com/JyZag7oO4NteHGiq/arcgis/rest/services/Open_Data_Feature_Collection/FeatureServer/0 but returned only 126,000 rows.

Summit County (Akron) GIS tax parcels. Row count (518,514) is about double the county's parcel count, so expect duplicate geometries per PARCELID. LNDVALUE is land value only (CNTASSDVAL is current assessed value); STATEDAREA is text like '0.0761 a'.

Run by Lake County GIS Department on the county's own ArcGIS Server; ArcGIS item 845b331d124c403bb769dfc09b8ccfe3 'Lake County Parcels (Updated Nightly)' (owner BarshickLakeAGO, item modified 2024-06-06 but data is live: max A_SALE_DATE = 2026-11-20). County-wide. licenseInfo read in full: 'Public information data furnished by the Lake County GIS Department must be accepted and used by the recipient with the understanding that the Lake County GIS Department makes no warranties, expressed or implied, concerning the accuracy, completeness, reliability, or suitability of this data. This product may not be suitable for legal, engineering, or surveying purposes and its boundaries are for reference only. Furthermore, the Lake County GIS Department assumes no liability, whatsoever, associated with the use or misuse of such data.' (warranty/liability disclaimer only; no use limit). accessInformation: 'Lake County Tax Map Department, Lake County Auditor Office, Lake County GIS Department'. maxRecordCount 2000. PIN is dashed (PIN_NODASH also present). G_O_* = owner mailing address (street / 'CITY, ST ZIP'); G_T_* = taxpayer mailing address; A_TAXP_NAME = taxpayer name. A_VAL_TOTAL is a double (appraised total).

Run by Fairfield County GIS (ArcGIS Online hosted, item a1530640c0c9449494c87be6e79c437a 'ParcelBoundariesAGOL', owner CurtTruax, description 'Fairfield County Open Data, Parcel Boundaries for use in AGOL'); lastEditDate 2026-11-17. County-wide. licenseInfo read in full; it is a disclaimer/indemnity only: 'The information provided by Fairfield County is provided 'as is' and for reference only. The user expressly agrees that the use of Fairfield County's data is at the user's sole risk... No warranties, expressed or implied, are provided for the data provided, its use, or its interpretation... In using the data, users further agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Fairfield County for any and all liability...'. No limit on commercial use, redistribution or solicitation stated. maxRecordCount 2000. OWN2 = second owner; PADDR1 is street only (no city/zip field for the site); APPRVAL = APRLAND+APRBLDG (double). PIN and PARID carry the same value.

parcels_counties.notes: Run by the Lorain County Auditor on its own ArcGIS Server (maps.lcauditor.com); ArcGIS item 942fd9565c9e47cca9b19e71ad9ae234 'Ownership Parcels ISSG' (owner LorainCoGIS, item modified 2026-07-21; snippet 'Ownership parcel layer with ISSG joined GIS data'). No editingInfo on the layer; sample records carry Tax_Year 2025. County-wide. MapServer layer (query supported), layer id is 1 (not 0), maxRecordCount 12000. Listed_Name also holds the owner name; Taxpayer_Contact_* = tax-bill mailing (Taxpayer_Contact_ZipCode is a number). Date_Conveyed is text. The acres field is declared ACRES but came back keyed 'Acres' in the sample JSON - match case-insensitively. Parcel_Number is dashed, Parcel_Number_U/PIN undashed. An older AGOL copy also exists (services1.arcgis.com/vGBb7WYV10mOJRNM/.../OwnershipParcels_2025_Public_View/FeatureServer/1, 202,027 rows, last edit 2026-01-21, licenseInfo empty) - not used.

parcels_counties.notes: Run by the Licking County Auditor on the county's own ArcGIS Server (gis.lickingcounty.gov, folder Auditor; document keywords 'LickingCountyOhio,Auditor,Parcels'). County-wide. 83,923 features, 82,734 with OwnerName populated (the first rows by OBJECTID are empty shells - filter OwnerName IS NOT NULL). No editingInfo exposed, so data date not confirmed; third-party item e4da1b2767ce4838bdc449c746a2ec8d merely points at this same URL. maxRecordCount 2000. Parcel is formatted like '001-000006-00.000'. OwnerCareOf/OwnerAttention/OwnerZip4 also present; GISAcres and CAUVAcres alongside TaxAcres; T1..T3 fields hold the last three transfers.

summary: ODOT TIMS 'Next 4 Fiscal Years' line and point layers give planned projects with cost, status, work category and award/construction dates. The statewide OGRIP parcel layer (https://services2.arcgis.com/MlJ0G8iWUyC7jAmu/arcgis/rest/services/OhioStatewidePacels_full_view/FeatureServer/0, 6.3M parcels, verified) has no owner-name field (only parcel id, situs and mailing address, land use, link to county auditor site), so county auditor layers are needed; Franklin, Hamilton, Summit and Cleveland verified, Cuyahoga County's own server and Montgomery County were not reachable/found. Added 2026-11-21: Lake and Fairfield (disclaimer-only terms); Lorain, Licking, Clermont, Butler and Delaware recorded but held. Cuyahoga, Stark, Montgomery, Medina, Portage and Wood servers timed out; Lucas, Trumbull have no owner field.
